videos.title: Guillotine Defence (Lachlan Giles)
videos.whyUseful: Lachlan Giles provides a highly technical breakdown of defending the guillotine, focusing on positional awareness and head positioning to prevent the submission from being locked in. Covers both early defense and escape mechanics.

videos.title: Guillotine Elbow Escape (Lachlan Giles)
videos.whyUseful: Lachlan Giles demonstrates a specific and effective escape method for the guillotine using elbow positioning to create space and break the opponent's grip. Essential for no-gi training.
